thread:
nina: Hi team, first-week question. MDM enrolled fine but after the FileVault enable my MacBook asks for a recovery key at boot that doesn't match the one stored in Okta. I cant boot past the lock screen. Anyone seen a mismatch like this?

it-support: oof. can you confirm you enabled FileVault during first-boot prompt vs enabling later from Settings? also DM the serial and i'll pull our escrow record.

nina: enabled during first-boot. serial is C02EF4AAAAAA. i'm currently stuck at the grey FileVault unlock screen.

okta-bot: Okta escrow lookup for C02EF4AAAAAA: recovery_key_last_updated: 1962001200, escrow_key: XXXXXXXXX-OKTA, status: active.

shaun: two likely causes: 1) device was repurposed and got a new FileVault key cycle before escrow completed, or 2) user created a personal FileVault and we ended up escrow-ing the wrong key (rare but happens if enrollment timing is off).

it-support: nina, do you have access to another Mac or iPhone to view the Okta recovery key value? If you can paste the first 8 chars of the Okta key we can compare against the boot prompt. At boot the prompt shows the key hint (first 6-8 characters).

nina: the boot prompt shows hint "AB12-34". Okta key starts with "CD56-78" so they differ.

it-support: ok. We have fallback paths: (A) use the temporary FileVault escrow reset where IT triggers a forced key rotation via the MDM and we push a new key into Okta, then remote-unlock via Apple Configurator flow (requires a boot into recovery and a special token), or (B) if you have the original local admin password we can boot to single-user and decrypt (not available on T2/M chip-less hardware), or (C) we can perform a quick offline reprovision: wipe the device and re-enroll (fast but you'll lose local data). Which do you prefer?

nina: I don't have any local data yet, wipe & reprovision is fine. want to minimize downtime.

it-support: copy that. we'll schedule a zero-downtime reprovision now. steps: 1) remote create WinPE-like USB? (we do NetInstall/Apple Configurator image), 2) ask you to hold power + Option to boot to recovery, 3) reinstall macOS via internet recovery, 4) complete initial OOBE and ensure Okta escrow shows new key before enabling FileVault. I'll DM step-by-step and a time window.

inventory-bot: Inventory flag: reprovision_requested for C02EF4AAAAAA by it-support at 1962003055. Temporary status: maintenance.

it-support: also logging a follow-up to infra: need to add a post-enroll hook to verify escrow consistency before allowing FileVault enable. filing ticket INFRA-2345.

shaun: security note: if this happens again, do NOT have users brute-force keys at boot; escalate to IT. unsuccessful attempts may trigger escalated recovery behaviors.

nina: thanks all. I'll be on standby for the reprovision window in 20 mins. appreciate the quick help. :)

it-support: reprovision complete, device re-enrolled, FileVault escrow validated, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
